Histogram of the Probability Integral Transform

Source: R/plot_diagnostic.R
plot_pit.Rd

Selects the histogram of the values \(F(y_i; \hat\theta_i)\) of the distribution function at the observations, on the density scale, with the uniform density and a pointwise binomial band for each bin.

Usage

plot_pit(bins = 20, seed = NULL, level = 0.95)

Arguments

bins

The number of bins.

seed

A single number that seeds the randomization, or NULL.

level

The level of the band.

Value

A PlotPit object, inheriting from diagnostic_plot.

Details

Under a correct model the values are uniform on \((0, 1)\). Each of the bins classes of equal width receives a binomial number of the \(n\) values, with probability \(1/\text{bins}\), and the band of level level is the interval of that binomial law divided by \(n\) times the bin width. For a discrete family the value is randomized between \(F(y_i^-)\) and \(F(y_i)\) (the values are \(\Phi\) of the quantile residuals of residuals.StatmodFit()), and seed makes it reproducible. A U shape indicates a response more dispersed than the model, a hump one less dispersed, and a slope a bias in the location.

See also

plot_calibration(), plot_qq(), diagnostics()

Examples

set.seed(1)
dd <- data.frame(x = runif(150))
dd$y <- rpois(150, exp(1 + dd$x))
fit <- statmod(y ~ x, distributions7::poisson_distrib(), dd)
ggplot2::autoplot(fit, plot_type = plot_pit(bins = 10, seed = 1))
